Riley: Quick RFC follow-up: propose separating ownership (who can accept writes) from residency (who holds bytes) for prefix cache. Goal: fewer blocking handoffs during eviction.

Nina: How do we keep read-after-write during async handoffs?

Riley: Writes carry owner_nonce. If a node sees an older nonce it forwards or returns retry. New owner only starts serving after it has residency_epoch >= owner_epoch and a fetch completes.

Omar: Forwarding window risks double-apply. Plan?

Riley: Require idempotent op_id on apply + fencing check. Lower-nonce applies rejected; duplicates deduped at storage. We'll emit a duplicate_op metric.

Zoe: Evict thrash concern. Any smoothing?

Riley: soft_demote flag + grace_ms. During grace reads still served; frequent reads trigger prefetch to stabilize residency. Also rate-limit migrations per-prefix.

Nina: Rollout and telemetry?

Riley: Feature flag ownership_split. Canary 1/10/50/100. Telemetry: forward_rate, forward_latency_p95/p99, duplicate_ops, eviction_churn, prefetch_triggers, read/write_p99/p999, error_rate. Add chaos tests for split/merge.

ci-bot: ci/ownership_split: unit 204 passed, integration 8/8. :white_check_mark:

Omar: I'll take split/merge chaos. Nina: can you own RAWR harness?

Nina: Yep. I'll add deterministic scenarios for mid-handoff writes.

Riley: I'll open rollout PR with flag + operator revert steps. Thanks all.
